info.title: SaaS Stock Deposit Control API
info.description: Backend API for the SaaS Stock Deposit Control system.

get.description:
Database-backed health check endpoint.
Probes database connectivity via the ConnectionProvider port.
Returns 200 OK if online, or 503 Service Unavailable if the probe fails.

post.description:
Login endpoint that verifies user credentials against the database
and returns a signed JWT token with user claims.

get.summary: Search articles by ID, barcode, or description
get.description: Supports exact lookup by Article ID or barcode, and tokenized description search. Dynamically masks financial data based on user role.

parameters.name: query

schema.description: Search query string (Article ID, barcode, or name token)
schema.title: Query

parameters.description: Search query string (Article ID, barcode, or name token)

schema.title: Response Search Articles Api V1 Articles Search Get

get.summary: List and filter articles with pagination and stock enrichment
get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of articles enriched with effective stock levels, optionally filtered by family, group, or search term.

schema.title: Response List Articles Api V1 Articles Get

get.summary: Get a single article by ID with effective stock
get.description: Retrieves a single article enriched with effective stock for the specified warehouse/deposit.

schema.title: Response Get Article Api V1 Articles  Id Articulo  Get

post.description: Registers physical stock audit count or variance, computes theoretical discrepancy (delta), voucher classification, and valorized cost.

get.description: Retrieves article catalog metadata alongside its current stock position scoped to a specific deposit.

schema.title: Response Get Article Stock Position Api V1 Stock Position Get

post.summary: Register batch stock audit entries (offline sync)
post.description: Processes queued audit records transmitted during mobile offline reconnection worker flush.

get.summary: Generate Shrinkage and Financial Erosion Report
get.description: Retrieves consolidated shrinkage movements (audit removals/bajas), applies VAT fiscal classification (0% for medications, parameterized default for others), and calculates total financial erosion. Restricted to administrator role.

parameters.name: default_vat_rate

schema.description: Default VAT rate applied to non-exempt product families
schema.title: Default Vat Rate

parameters.description: Default VAT rate applied to non-exempt product families

get.summary: Generate Goods Received and Injected Capital Report
get.description: Retrieves consolidated goods received movements (audit additions/altas), applies VAT fiscal classification (0% for medications, parameterized default for others), and calculates total injected capital. Restricted to administrator role.

parameters.name: default_vat_rate

schema.description: Default VAT rate applied to non-exempt product families
schema.title: Default Vat Rate

parameters.description: Default VAT rate applied to non-exempt product families

get.summary: Generate Daily Inventory Cost Ledger Report
get.description: Retrieves consolidated daily inventory balance (Goods Received vs Shrinkage), calculates net patrimonial variation (Delta = Altas - Mermas). Exclusive to administrator role.
